title: Test Petitioner vs State Of Karnataka on 12 March, 2025
doc:
Karnataka High Court
Test Petitioner vs State Of Karnataka on 12 March, 2025
IN THE HIGH COURT OF KARNATAKA AT BENGALURU

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking anticipatory bail.

The petition is allowed subject to conditions.
